problems.quote: Alarm passes; watches quietly and stands at doorway
problems.evidence: Only his sister was standing up.
problems.explanation: The text says only that the sister is standing; it never places her at the doorway or says she watches quietly, so the location is invented and presented as the text's.

result.note: Nearly all records stay within the text read so far, with calendar dates and readings labelled as guessed or inferred; the only unsupported detail is the sister's position at the doorway.
